description: Independent research in parallel: one to three standard subagents, merged into one table (G2, G3 proxy).
prompt: Compare the licence, latest release date and maintainer activity of three Python HTTP clients: requests, httpx and aiohttp. I want a table.

replies.report: httpx: BSD-3-Clause; latest release 0.28.1 (2024-12-06); 3 active maintainers, issues triaged weekly. Sources: https://pypi.org/project/httpx/
aiohttp: Apache-2.0; latest release 3.12.15 (2025-07-29); very active, several releases a month. Sources: https://pypi.org/project/aiohttp/
requests: Apache-2.0; latest release 2.32.5 (2025-08-18); maintenance mode, few maintainers. Sources: https://pypi.org/project/requests/

arguments.brief:
## Goal
Report the licence, latest release (version and date) and maintainer activity of the Python HTTP client requests.

## Context
Part of a comparison table; use PyPI and the project's repository.

## Constraints
Public sources only; cite every URL.

## Acceptance
- Licence identifier, latest version with date, and a one-line activity summary, each with a source URL.

## Output format
One line per field, then the source URLs.

## Goal
Report the licence, latest release (version and date) and maintainer activity of the Python HTTP client httpx.

## Context
Part of a comparison table; use PyPI and the project's repository.

## Constraints
Public sources only; cite every URL.

## Acceptance
- Licence identifier, latest version with date, and a one-line activity summary, each with a source URL.

## Output format
One line per field, then the source URLs.

## Goal
Report the licence, latest release (version and date) and maintainer activity of the Python HTTP client aiohttp.

## Context
Part of a comparison table; use PyPI and the project's repository.

## Constraints
Public sources only; cite every URL.

## Acceptance
- Licence identifier, latest version with date, and a one-line activity summary, each with a source URL.

## Output format
One line per field, then the source URLs.

reference.content:
| Client | Licence | Latest release | Activity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| requests | Apache-2.0 | 2.32.5 (2025-08-18) | maintenance mode |
| httpx | BSD-3-Clause | 0.28.1 (2024-12-06) | active, weekly triage |
| aiohttp | Apache-2.0 | 3.12.15 (2025-07-29) | very active |

Sources: https://pypi.org/project/requests/, https://pypi.org/project/httpx/, https://pypi.org/project/aiohttp/
